test_input: Press RIGHT for 5 seconds, then UP for 2 seconds, then LEFT for 3 seconds, then DOWN for 2 seconds. Repeat until game over. Press R to restart. Press ESC to quit.
expected_win_output: No win condition; play continues until collision. (The game ends with 'GAME OVER'.)
expected_lose_output: Console prints: 'GAME OVER' and the final score (e.g. 'GAME OVER' then '5'). On-screen: big 'GAME OVER' and 'Final Score: N'.
notes: Coverage: Implements all active requirements. Files: game/snake_game.py (entry point, loop, rendering, input, score, game over, restart), game/snake.py (Snake class: movement, growth, collision), game/food.py (Food class: spawns avoiding snake), game/constants.py (layout, colors, FPS). Assets: procedural colored rectangles only. Behavior details: - Grid: 20x20 cells rendered in the play area. - Snake: starts centered with length 3, moves right at FPS=10 (one cell per tick). - Controls: Arrow keys change direction (no direct reversal). - Eating food: increases length by 1, increments score by 1, prints new score to console, and respawns food in a random empty cell. - Collisions: hitting wall or self prints 'GAME OVER' to console, shows on-screen message, and freezes the snake until 'R' is pressed. - Restart: pressing 'R' resets snake, food, and score to initial state. - Quit: pressing Escape or closing the window exits. Known limitations: None significant; the game uses simple blocking console prints for score and game over. Fonts use pygame.font.Font(None, size).
